items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for payment: 11.12.2026. Checked against the Sachsen-Anhalt holiday calendar, 11.12.2026 is a Friday and not a public holiday, so no weekend/holiday shift under §193 BGB is needed. The due date stands as written; allowing one business day for a bank transfer to arrive (§675s BGB) means sending the payment by 10.12.2026 at the latest to be safe, but the stated due date itself is 11.12.2026.

warnings: The letter states it was hand-delivered into the letterbox by the caretaker ('Zugestellt durch unseren Hausmeister: Einwurf in den Briefkasten am 18.11.2026, 9 Uhr') rather than sent by post; this is a private landlord's letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule for authority mail applies, and the printed due date of 11.12.2026 is taken as written.

Before paying, double-check that the IBAN printed on the letter (DE84 8105 3272 0005 5727 20) matches the account you have used for this landlord before, since a well-formed IBAN does not by itself prove who owns the account.
